Refunds requested match the refunds list provided; proceed to pay each customer their net balance using net_balance tool and record one payout per customer.
net_balance expects a customer identifier, not an order_id. I must list orders/refunds to map order_ids to customer ids for this batch.

Refunds coverage seems for order_ids 201,203,204. Map those to customers: 201->birch, 203->acme, 204->birch. Now I must pay each customer their net balance (orders minus refunds). I will compute net_balance per customer (acme, birch, cobalt) and then record one payout per customer. Refunds table matches the requested refunds for this batch (order_ids 201,203,204). Proceed to compute net balances per customer (acme, birch, cobalt) using net_balance tool, then record one payout per customer.
